practicals.title: Create a Pandas Series from a dictionary of values and from an ndarray.
practicals.title_hi: मानों की डिक्शनरी से और ndarray से Pandas सीरीज़ बनाइए।
practicals.code:
# Program 1: Series from a dictionary and from an ndarray
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

marks = {"English": 82, "Maths": 91, "Physics": 76, "Chemistry": 88, "IP": 95}
s1 = pd.Series(marks)
print("Series from a dictionary:")
print(s1)

arr = np.array([12.5, 15.0, 17.5, 20.0])
s2 = pd.Series(arr, index=["Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4"])
print("\nSeries from an ndarray:")
print(s2)
practicals.output:

Physics      76
Chemistry    88
IP           95
dtype: int64

Series from an ndarray:
Q1    12.5
Q2    15.0
Q3    17.5
Q4    20.0
dtype: float64

print("\nPercentage of term 2 out of 50 (term2 / 50 * 100):")

practicals.title: Use head(), tail(), indexing, slicing, loc and iloc on a Series of monthly rainfall.
practicals.title_hi: मासिक वर्षा की सीरीज़ पर head(), tail(), इंडेक्सिंग, स्लाइसिंग, loc और iloc का उपयोग कीजिए।
practicals.code:
# Program 3: head(), tail(), selection, indexing and slicing
import pandas as pd

rain = pd.Series([12, 8, 15, 30, 85, 160, 240, 210, 140, 60, 20, 10],
                 index=["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun",
                        "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"])
print("First 3 months (head):")
print(rain.head(3))
print("\nLast 2 months (tail):")
print(rain.tail(2))
print("\nRainfall in July (by label):", rain["Jul"])
print("Rainfall in the 3rd month (by position):", rain.iloc[2])
print("\nJune to September (label slice, end included):")
print(rain.loc["Jun":"Sep"])
print("\nPositions 0 to 2 (position slice, end excluded):")
print(rain.iloc[0:3])
print("\nEvery third month:")
print(rain[::3])

practicals.title: Given a Series, print all the elements that are above the 75th percentile.
practicals.title_hi: दी गई सीरीज़ के वे सभी तत्व प्रिंट कीजिए जो 75वें प्रतिशतक (percentile) से ऊपर हैं।
practicals.code:
# Program 4: Elements above the 75th percentile
import pandas as pd

scores = pd.Series([56, 78, 91, 45, 83, 67, 99, 72, 88, 61],
                   index=["S1", "S2", "S3", "S4", "S5", "S6", "S7", "S8", "S9", "S10"])
p75 = scores.quantile(0.75)
print("75th percentile =", p75)
print("Scores above the 75th percentile:")
print(scores[scores > p75])
practicals.output:
75th percentile = 86.75
Scores above the 75th percentile:
S3    91
S7    99
S9    88
dtype: int64

practicals.title: Display the attributes of a Series (index, values, size, dtype, empty) and filter it with Boolean conditions.
practicals.title_hi: सीरीज़ के गुण (index, values, size, dtype, empty) दिखाइए और बूलियन शर्तों से उसे फ़िल्टर कीजिए।
practicals.code:
# Program 5: Series attributes and Boolean indexing
import pandas as pd

price = pd.Series([45.0, 30.5, 120.0, 15.0, 60.0],
                  index=["Pen", "Pencil", "Geometry box", "Eraser", "Notebook"])
print("index :", list(price.index))
print("values:", price.values)
print("size  :", price.size)
print("dtype :", price.dtype)
print("empty :", price.empty)
print("\nItems costing more than 40:")
print(price[price > 40])
print("\nItems between 20 and 60:")
print(price[(price >= 20) & (price <= 60)])
print("\nSorted by price:")
print(price.sort_values())

practicals.title: Create a DataFrame from a dictionary of Series and from a list of dictionaries, and display it.
practicals.title_hi: Series की डिक्शनरी से और डिक्शनरियों की सूची से डेटाफ़्रेम बनाइए और दिखाइए।

# Program 6: DataFrame from a dictionary of Series and a list of dictionaries
import pandas as pd

names = pd.Series(["Ira", "Om", "Pia", "Raj"])
ages = pd.Series([16, 17, 16, 17])
house = pd.Series(["Red", "Blue", "Green", "Blue"])
df1 = pd.DataFrame({"Name": names, "Age": ages, "House": house})
print("From a dictionary of Series:")
print(df1)

rows = [{"City": "Delhi", "Temp": 31, "Humidity": 45},
        {"City": "Chennai", "Temp": 34, "Humidity": 70},
        {"City": "Shimla", "Temp": 18}]          # Humidity missing for Shimla
df2 = pd.DataFrame(rows)
print("\nFrom a list of dictionaries (missing value becomes NaN):")
print(df2)

practicals.title: Create a DataFrame quarterly sales where each row contains the item category, item name and expenditure. Group the rows by category and print the total expenditure per category.
practicals.title_hi: तिमाही बिक्री का डेटाफ़्रेम बनाइए जिसकी हर पंक्ति में वस्तु श्रेणी, वस्तु का नाम और व्यय हो। पंक्तियों को श्रेणी के अनुसार समूहित करके प्रति श्रेणी कुल व्यय प्रिंट कीजिए।
practicals.code:
# Program 7: Group by category and total expenditure
import pandas as pd

sales = pd.DataFrame({
    "Category": ["Electronics", "Furniture", "Electronics", "Stationery",
                 "Furniture", "Stationery", "Electronics"],
    "Item": ["Laptop", "Chair", "Printer", "Notebooks", "Table", "Pens", "Mouse"],
    "Expenditure": [55000, 4500, 12000, 1800, 9000, 600, 900],
})
print(sales)
print("\nTotal expenditure per category:")
print(sales.groupby("Category")["Expenditure"].sum())

print("Number of dimensions:", result.ndim)

practicals.title: Add, select, delete and rename rows and columns of a DataFrame.
practicals.title_hi: डेटाफ़्रेम की पंक्तियाँ और स्तंभ जोड़िए, चुनिए, हटाइए और उनका नाम बदलिए।
practicals.code:
# Program 9: Operations on rows and columns
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({"Hindi": [78, 85, 69], "English": [82, 74, 90]},
                  index=["Anu", "Bilal", "Charvi"])
print("Original:")
print(df)

df["Maths"] = [91, 66, 88]                 # add a column
df.loc["Deep"] = [72, 80, 77]              # add a row
print("\nAfter adding column Maths and row Deep:")
print(df)

print("\nSelect column English:")
print(df["English"])
print("\nSelect row Bilal:")
print(df.loc["Bilal"])

df = df.drop("Hindi", axis=1)              # delete a column
df = df.drop("Charvi")                     # delete a row
df = df.rename(columns={"English": "Eng"}, index={"Anu": "Anushka"})
print("\nAfter deleting Hindi and Charvi, and renaming:")
print(df)

practicals.title: Iterate over the rows of a DataFrame using iterrows() and over its columns using items().
practicals.title_hi: iterrows() से डेटाफ़्रेम की पंक्तियों पर और items() से उसके स्तंभों पर पुनरावृत्ति (iteration) कीजिए।
practicals.code:
# Program 10: Iterating over a DataFrame
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({"Item": ["Rice", "Dal", "Oil"],
                   "Qty": [5, 2, 1],
                   "Rate": [60, 120, 180]})

print("Row by row (iterrows):")
for idx, row in df.iterrows():
    print(idx, row["Item"], "costs", row["Qty"] * row["Rate"])

print("\nColumn by column (items):")
for col, values in df.items():
    print(col, ":", list(values))
practicals.output:

2 Oil costs 180

practicals.title: Use label-based indexing (loc), position-based indexing (iloc) and Boolean indexing on a DataFrame of players.
practicals.title_hi: खिलाड़ियों के डेटाफ़्रेम पर लेबल-आधारित (loc), स्थिति-आधारित (iloc) और बूलियन इंडेक्सिंग कीजिए।
practicals.code:
# Program 11: loc, iloc and Boolean indexing
import pandas as pd

players = pd.DataFrame({
    "Team": ["India", "Australia", "India", "England", "India"],
    "Runs": [512, 430, 610, 388, 275],
    "Matches": [10, 9, 11, 8, 7],
}, index=["Virat", "Steve", "Shubman", "Joe", "Rishabh"])
print(players)
print("\nloc - rows Steve to Joe, columns Runs and Matches:")
print(players.loc["Steve":"Joe", ["Runs", "Matches"]])
print("\niloc - first two rows, first two columns:")
print(players.iloc[0:2, 0:2])
print("\nPlayers with more than 400 runs:")
print(players[players["Runs"] > 400])
print("\nIndian players with more than 300 runs:")
print(players[(players["Team"] == "India") & (players["Runs"] > 300)])

practicals.title: Filter out rows based on different criteria, such as duplicate rows.
practicals.title_hi: विभिन्न मानदंडों के आधार पर पंक्तियाँ छाँटिए, जैसे दोहराई गई (duplicate) पंक्तियाँ।
practicals.code:
# Program 12: Finding and removing duplicate rows
import pandas as pd

entries = pd.DataFrame({
    "RollNo": [1, 2, 2, 3, 4, 4, 5],
    "Name": ["Aman", "Bina", "Bina", "Chirag", "Disha", "Disha", "Ekta"],
    "Event": ["Race", "Quiz", "Quiz", "Chess", "Dance", "Quiz", "Race"],
})
print("All entries:")
print(entries)
print("\nIs the row a duplicate of an earlier row?")
print(entries.duplicated())
print("\nDuplicate rows:")
print(entries[entries.duplicated()])
print("\nAfter removing duplicate rows:")
print(entries.drop_duplicates())
print("\nOne row per student (duplicates by RollNo removed):")
print(entries.drop_duplicates(subset="RollNo"))
print("\nOnly the Quiz entries:")
print(entries[entries["Event"] == "Quiz"])

practicals.title: Use head(), tail(), sort_values() and aggregate functions (max, min, mean, sum, count) on a DataFrame of student marks.
practicals.title_hi: विद्यार्थियों के अंकों के डेटाफ़्रेम पर head(), tail(), sort_values() और समूह फ़ंक्शन (max, min, mean, sum, count) का उपयोग कीजिए।
practicals.code:
# Program 13: head, tail, sorting and aggregate functions
import pandas as pd

marks = pd.DataFrame({
    "Name": ["Aditya", "Bhumi", "Chaitanya", "Devika", "Farhan", "Gauri"],
    "Maths": [78, 92, 65, 88, 71, 95],
    "IP": [85, 90, 70, 94, 80, 89],
})
print("First 3 rows:")
print(marks.head(3))
print("\nLast 2 rows:")
print(marks.tail(2))
print("\nSorted by IP marks (highest first):")
print(marks.sort_values("IP", ascending=False))
print("\nHighest marks:\n", marks[["Maths", "IP"]].max(), sep="")
print("\nLowest marks:\n", marks[["Maths", "IP"]].min(), sep="")
print("\nAverage marks:\n", marks[["Maths", "IP"]].mean(), sep="")
print("\nTotal of each student:")
marks["Total"] = marks["Maths"] + marks["IP"]
print(marks)
print("\nNumber of students:", marks["Name"].count())

practicals.title: Import data from a CSV file into a DataFrame, process it, and export the result to another CSV file.
practicals.title_hi: CSV फ़ाइल से डेटा डेटाफ़्रेम में आयात कीजिए, उसे संसाधित कीजिए और परिणाम दूसरी CSV फ़ाइल में निर्यात कीजिए।
practicals.code:
# Program 14: Importing and exporting data between Pandas and CSV files
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv("students.csv")
print("Data read from students.csv:")
print(df)

df["Total"] = df["Maths"] + df["Science"] + df["English"]
df["Percent"] = (df["Total"] / 3).round(2)
toppers = df[df["Percent"] >= 80]
print("\nStudents with 80% or more:")
print(toppers[["Name", "Class", "Percent"]])

toppers.to_csv("toppers.csv", index=False)
print("\nSaved to toppers.csv. Reading it back:")
print(pd.read_csv("toppers.csv"))

# Program 16: Importing and exporting data between Pandas and MySQL
import pandas as pd

practicals.title: SQL Set 5 – Two tables ITEM and SALE: GROUP BY with HAVING, ORDER BY, and an equi-join to show each sale with the item name and amount.
practicals.title_hi: SQL सेट 5 – दो तालिकाएँ ITEM और SALE: HAVING के साथ GROUP BY, ORDER BY, और हर बिक्री को वस्तु के नाम व राशि के साथ दिखाने के लिए इक्वी-जॉइन।

steps.sql: CREATE DATABASE store;

INSERT INTO item VALUES ('I01', 'Keyboard', 650), ('I02', 'Mouse', 350), ('I03', 'Monitor', 7800), ('I04', 'Webcam', 1900);

steps.question: Q1. Each sale with the item name and amount (equi-join).
steps.sql: SELECT sale_id, iname, qty, price, qty * price AS amount FROM item, sale WHERE item.icode = sale.icode;

steps.question: Q2. Total quantity sold in each city.
steps.sql: SELECT city, SUM(qty) FROM sale GROUP BY city;

steps.question: Q3. Items sold more than 5 pieces in all.
steps.sql: SELECT iname, SUM(qty) FROM item, sale WHERE item.icode = sale.icode GROUP BY iname HAVING SUM(qty) > 5;

steps.question: Q4. Total sale amount of each item, highest first.
steps.sql: SELECT iname, SUM(qty * price) AS total FROM item, sale WHERE item.icode = sale.icode GROUP BY iname ORDER BY total DESC;

steps.question: Q5. Number of sales and average quantity per city.
steps.sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*), AVG(qty) FROM sale GROUP BY city;
